fuel_basis: TFDE (tri-fuel diesel electric) propulsion/generation plant -- one of its fuel modes is boil-off natural gas, per the vessel's documented TFDE classification (industry-standard for this technology).

Krk's BOG-fuelled DFDE module).
confirmed_how: Baird Maritime (2019): 'The time charter is expected to be fulfilled through the conversion of GasLog Singapore, a 155,000-cubic-metre, tri-fuel diesel electric (TFDE) LNG carrier built in 2010...
